blurb: Guests can enjoy massage therapy, facial treatments, body treatments, and access to a heated pool, year-round outdoor hot tub, sauna, and relaxation areas. The spa includes sensory and walking paths, artfully designed gardens, and a barrel sauna. Wellness classes such as aerial yoga and sound meditation are offered, with private classes available by arrangement.
extraNote: Dining credit and fitness classes must be used on the day of visit · Restrictions and blackout dates apply to Day Pass offers · Located on the Kenoza Hall property with lake views
